critic.fix_suggestion: Apply a vertical extrusion/inset to the fuselage surface at the main and service door locations. Define these as 0.15m deep rectangular frames with a width of 1.2m for main doors and 0.8m for service doors, oriented perpendicular to the fuselage skin to create distinct recessed outlines.

discrepancies.reference: A multi-paneled array of distinct windows with defined frames

discrepancies.reference: Individual small rectangular windows spaced evenly along the fuselage
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: replace line with repeated small boxes
